source.title: Anyone else having issues getting Mycobloom to mill via Create All?
source.author: Feaver

quote: craft one stack of Nacreous Pigment
notes: Original firsthand September 2024 account: a nominal Create All request for 1,000 Mycobloom may produce one stack of Nacreous Pigment and then stop with a 'Requires 10 Mycobloom' error despite further herbs in the reagent bag. A forum reply suggests first-stack targeting; not independently proven as general mechanic or fixed now. Confirms a source-stated 10-herb operation requirement and demonstrates that queued/nominal mills cannot be assumed completed mills. No input herb rank, pigment output rank ID/quantity, measured series count, skill, specialization, refund basis, build, per-output hits or zeros is stated. Reference-only historical execution/reporting caveat, not a 1-cast yield trial or numerical evidence.
